svg.aria-label: Six graphs in two rows and three columns: the terms J(t) on -2/3 to 2/5, H(u) on -2/5 to 2/5 and G(d) on 0 to 16/15 of the west stress, each on its own vertical scale, with the range written in a corner. The top row has the terms of Phi_W, where the length of the force on D enters J (R = R0) and H and G are plain harmonics (R = 0); the bottom row has those of Phi_D, where the lengths enter H and G. Each curve lies above its dashed chords on either side of 0, where J and H have a convex corner
